`tax_for` in `src/billing/tax.py` now rounds half-up. I haven't run it, and the repo has no tests that cover it.

The function was only a `NotImplementedError` stub, so there was no existing rounding to change. I wrote the whole thing:

```python
tax = Decimal(amount_cents) * Decimal(str(rate))
return int(tax.quantize(Decimal("1"), rounding=ROUND_HALF_UP))
```

It returns integer cents. For example, 1050 cents at a 5% rate gives 52.5, which rounds to 53 (half-even would have given 52). I assumed `rate` is a fraction like `0.05`, so check that against how callers will pass it.

A stored project memory said tax uses `ROUND_HALF_EVEN`, as decided with finance in March 2026. I updated it to say half-up, since you've now said finance reversed that.
